title: Esper analyzer manifest
description: An analyzer behind Esper's contract (D12): what it is, what it provides, and how its container is built and run. One manifest per analyzer, in analyzers/<name>/manifest.yaml.

name.description: The analyzer's name, also the name of its folder: the facts it brings name it as their source, with its version.

version.description: The version of the tool the image runs: the facts it brings are tagged <name>@<version>. It is part of the image's tag, so it holds only what a tag may: letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'.

languages.description: The languages whose files it reads.

provides.description: What its output brings: edges.resolve, the references of call sites and the implementations of interface methods; flows, dataflow paths (not imported yet).

answers.description: snapshot: run while a snapshot is indexed, on the whole of it; question: run for one question about a snapshot (not run yet).

image.description: The container image: built by Esper from a Dockerfile in the analyzer's folder.

fetch.description: The arguments that fetch the snapshot's dependencies, given to the image's entry point: run with the network, the source read-only and the dependency cache writable. Absent when the analyzer needs no dependency.

analyze.description: The arguments that analyze the snapshot, given to the image's entry point: run without network, the source and the dependency cache read-only; writes /esper/out/analysis.jsonl.
